about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Mike Ezell

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JEREMY MALONE POST OFFICE
statements.title: JEREMY MALONE POST OFFICE
sentences: Deputy Jeremy Malone was a dedicated law enforcement officer for over 21 years of service to the people of South Mississippi.
As a former law enforcement officer myself, I know the sacrifices that come from wearing a badge.
Deputy Malone represented the very best of law enforcement in South Mississippi.
Madam Speaker, I rise today in support of my legislation to designate the United States Postal Service facility located at 825 Highway 198 in Beaumont, Mississippi, as the Jeremy Malone Post Office.
I urge my colleagues to support this legislation and join me in honoring the life of a true American hero.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: DEFENDING AMERICAN PROPERTY ABROAD ACT OF 2026
statements.title: DEFENDING AMERICAN PROPERTY ABROAD ACT OF 2026
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 7084, the Defending American Property Abroad Act of 2026.
Mr. Speaker, I urge support of this legislation and reserve the balance of my time.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REAUTHORIZATION OF INTEGRATED COASTAL AND OCEAN OBSERVATION SYSTEM ACT OF 2009
statements.title: REAUTHORIZATION OF INTEGRATED COASTAL AND OCEAN OBSERVATION SYSTEM ACT OF 2009

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2189, LAW-ENFORCEMENT INNOVATE TO DE-ESCALATE ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 261, UNDERSEA CABLE PROTECTION ACT OF 202
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 2189, LAW-ENFORCEMENT INNOVATE TO DE-ESCALATE ACT; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 261, UNDERSEA CABLE PROTECTION ACT OF 2025; PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF...
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 2189, the Law-Enforcement Innovate to De-Escalate Act of 2025, bipartisan legislation that modernizes our Federal firearms laws to better align with 21st century technology and the real-world needs of law enforcement officers and the communities they protect.

H.R. 2189 fixes that, establishing clear, commonsense definitions and regulatory pathways so that our law enforcement professionals can get the equipment that they need without unnecessary delay or confusion.
It upholds our commitment to the rule of law, supports law enforcement safety, and provides additional tools that encourages de-escalation and reduced violence wherever possible.
As a fellow law enforcement officer, I thank Congressman Fitzgerald for leading this valiant effort.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``yes'' vote on H.R. 2189.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CORMORANT RELIEF ACT OF 2025
statements.title: CORMORANT RELIEF ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong support of H.R. 2293, the Cormorant Relief Act of 2025, which reinstates the Aquaculture Depredation Order for double-crested cormorants.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

Madam Chairman, I rise today to support this legislation which was introduced by Chairman Graves along with myself and Ranking Members Larsen and Carbajal.
Madam Speaker, I appreciate the work of Chairman Graves on this legislation along with Ranking Member Larsen and Subcommittee Ranking Member Carbajal, and I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE ONBOARD VESSELS
statements.title: CONTROLLED SUBSTANCE ONBOARD VESSELS
sentences: H.R. 2351 amends the Maritime Drug Law Enforcement Act, removing ambiguities in the current law which prohibits the prosecution of cases involving unmanned or autonomous vessels.
It will also give the Coast Guard the parity to police other armed services with regard to rapid treatment of drug overdoses, keeping guardsmen safe from accidental exposure.
H.R. 2351 implements changes that will help secure our maritime border and increase safety on our seas.

statements.title: MARITIME SUPPLY CHAIN SECURITY ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of H.R. 2390, the Maritime Supply Chain Security Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BABY CHANGING ON BOARD ACT
statements.title: BABY CHANGING ON BOARD ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I move to suspend the rules and pass the bill (H.R. 248) to require Amtrak to install baby changing tables in bathrooms on passenger rail cars.
The bill requires Amtrak to install baby changing tables in all ADA- accessible restrooms on trains owned by Amtrak.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE OUR PORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SECURE OUR PORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, H.R. 252 takes important steps to strengthen the security of our supply chains by limiting the ability of the Chinese, Russian, North Korean, or Iranian state-owned entities to own, lease, or operate port terminals in this country.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS
statements.title: EXPRESSING SUPPORT FOR LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my bipartisan resolution honoring the brave men and women who serve in local law enforcement.
As a former sheriff, a son of a police officer, and a 42-year career police officer, I have walked in their shoes.
When others run away from danger, law enforcement and first responders run toward it.
During my time in Congress, Mississippi has lost too many heroes: In June 2023, Madison Police Officer Randy Tyler was shot and killed while responding to a hostage situation.
In August 2024, Summit Police Patrolman Troy Floyd was shot and killed during a regular, routine traffic checkpoint.
Fallen heroes like these officers are being honored this week during National Police Week as thousands of law enforcement officers come to the Nation's Capital together here in Washington.
That is why there is no better time for us to pass this resolution and make it clear that we stand for law enforcement.
My resolution expresses our gratitude to local law enforcement and their families for their service and sacrifice.
We have seen targeted, ambush-style attacks on law enforcement officers.
It is time to make clear that we stand with the men and women of local law enforcement who protect each and every one of our communities with honor and courage.
This police week, I urge my colleagues to join me in voting for this resolution to send a clear message that Congress backs the thin blue line.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF OCEAN ENERGY MANAGEMENT RELATING TO "PROTECTION OF MARINE ARCHAEOLOGICAL RESOURCES"
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE BUREAU OF OCEAN ENERGY MANAGEMENT RELATING TO "PROTECTION OF MARINE ARCHAEOLOGICAL RESOURCES"
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in favor of S.J. Res. 11, a Congressional Review Act to reverse the Bureau of Ocean Energy Management, or BOEM, rule that targeted oil and gas production in our Outer Continental Shelf.
That is why I am proud to stand up today for the American workers and consumers by leading the House version of this CRA to reverse this detrimental rule.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support S.J. Res. 11, and I look forward to the President signing this into law.
